name: typesafe-jev-mcp-tool-result-screening
displayName: TypeSafe Jev MCP Tool Result Screening
description:
Screens the results of MCP tools/call requests using TypeSafe AI's Jev System One model, before the agent reads them.
Sends the result's text, with the tool name and arguments, to Jev with a configurable battery of typed questions (calibrated yes/no, a position on an operator-defined scale, or a choice between operator-defined options) and withholds the result when any question's answer crosses its threshold: the agent gets a tool result marked isError instead, so its run continues. Monitor mode only records the hit.
The default battery asks whether the result contains instructions addressed to the AI, tries to change the agent's task, asks for data to be sent out, or asks for an action the agent wasn't asked to take; tool rules set the questions, the mode and fail-open per tool, by exact name or * for every other tool.
JSON and event-stream responses are handled; other MCP methods pass through, and results that can't be screened pass through by default and are recorded.
